title: 2027 Ford Maverick: Price Cuts, No More Turbo on Cheap Trims (What Changed)
description:
Ford just cut the price of two Maverick trims by thousands of dollars, and at the same time, took the turbo engine away from two others. The truck that started at twenty-two thousand, five hundred dollars in twenty twenty-two is changing again for twenty twenty-seven. And the numbers behind it explain why. Here is what changed on the twenty twenty-seven Ford Maverick, and who should buy it.

Get the 2027 Truck Buyer's Guide: [LINK HERE]

Chapters:
0:00 Intro
2:00 1. The Lobo price cut
2:56 2. The Tremor price cut
4:01 3. The turbo is removed
5:45 4. The towing package
6:50 The price history
13:53 Who should buy it
15:31 What to check before you buy in 2027

Sources:
For the twenty twenty-seven changes, our main source is a report by The Truth About Cars, published on August twenty-eighth, twenty twenty-six, which covers a pricing document for the new model year. We also use Autoblog and Ford's own sales releases, plus iSeeCars for resale. Pricing documents can change before the trucks arrive, so treat the twenty twenty-seven prices as reported, not final. Every source is listed in the description.
